name: avr-asm-intellisense
description: AVR-aware completion and highlighting for GNU assembly in VS Code and PlatformIO projects.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Static syntax highlighting and built-in completions work in untrusted workspaces. avr-gcc preprocessing for <avr/io.h> symbols only runs after the workspace is trusted.

avrAsmIntellisense.compilerPath.description: Optional path to avr-gcc. When blank, use PlatformIO metadata and then avr-gcc on PATH.

avrAsmIntellisense.mcu.description: AVR MCU name passed to avr-gcc, for example atmega328p.

avrAsmIntellisense.platformioEnvironment.description: PlatformIO environment name used when discovering board_build.mcu from platformio.ini.

avrAsmIntellisense.platformioPath.description: Optional path to the PlatformIO executable. When blank, use the PlatformIO IDE path, standard installation, or PATH.

avrAsmIntellisense.usePlatformioMetadata.description: Use trusted PlatformIO project metadata to discover the AVR compiler, MCU, defines, and include paths.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run check && npm run test:coverage && vsce package --no-dependencies
